summary: Verified punctuation sanitize fix for photo-supported evidence in Daily Report summary. The fix strips trailing punctuation (.;:, etc.) from photo observations before joining them with semicolons.

unit_test.details: Test verifies that observations with trailing punctuation like '.', '..', ';' are cleaned before joining

test_cases.input: Paving machine is in operation with fresh asphalt being laid.
test_cases.output: Paving machine is in operation with fresh asphalt being laid

test_cases.input: Illuminated work area indicates night operation..
test_cases.output: Illuminated work area indicates night operation

frontend_sanitize_function.details: Mirrors backend implementation for client-side fallback

existing_report_check.old_summary:

existing_report_check.explanation: This report was created BEFORE the sanitize fix was applied. The malformed punctuation (.;, ..) is expected in old data.

summary_draft_api.details: New summaries generated via the API do not contain malformed punctuation

fix_verification.defect: Photo-supported evidence sentence contained malformed punctuation like '.;' or '..' when joining photo observations
fix_verification.root_cause: Photo observations from AI analysis sometimes include trailing punctuation, and when joined with '; ' separator, this created patterns like '.;' or '..'
fix_verification.verification_result: FIXED - New summaries will have clean punctuation. Old reports retain their original (malformed) data.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The punctuation sanitize fix has been verified. The _clean_photo_sentence function in backend and cleanPhotoSentence in frontend both strip trailing punctuation from photo observations before joining them. The old report DR-2026-03438 still has malformed punctuation because it was created before the fix - this is expected and not a bug.
